description: Improve logging across the codebase by using structured fields instead of embedding data in log messages, and adjust log levels to be more appropriate for each situation. This will make logs more machine-readable and improve log analysis capabilities.
functional_requirements: Replace embedded data in log messages with structured fields (e.g., use key-value pairs instead of string interpolation)
Review and adjust log levels across all modified modules to ensure appropriate severity classification
Ensure consistent logging patterns are applied throughout the ak-common and ak-axum packages
